text: おおきく　ひろげた　りっぱな　つばさを　あいてに　ぶつけて　こうげきする。

structure.jp: おおきく　ひろげた　りっぱな　つばさを
あいてに　ぶつけて

patterns.name: verb + noun
patterns.span: おおきく　ひろげた　りっぱな　つばさ
patterns.explanation: A verb phrase placed right before a thing describes that thing. おおきく　ひろげた　りっぱな　つばさ = 'splendid wings that it has spread wide'.

patterns.name: 〜て (linking)
patterns.explanation: The て ending joins this action to the next one; here the first action is the way the second is done. あいてに　ぶつけて　こうげきする = 'attacks by slamming them into the opponent'.
